addresses.name: CMessageHandler::GotoProvinceForMessage
addresses.comment: **The Goto of nearly every message**: the callback 87 raises hand PostMessage<CMessageHandler>, 119 types by a walk from their names. Centres the map on the message's province (+0x44), else on the acting capital of its first country (+0x38), of the second (+0x40) where the first is null. Answers true whether or not there was a province, so the popup stays up. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-messagegoto.md.
addresses.evidence: decompiled and read whole, ret 4 at VA 0x6996EB; pushed before the post at every CMessageHandler raise but WELOSECB's

addresses.name: CMessageHandler::GotoUnitForMessage
addresses.comment: **The Goto of a unit's message** (EXPRETURNED, EXPRETURNEDWE, the three UNITARRIVED): finds the unit by the persistent id at +0x68/+0x6C, clears the selection, selects it and centres on its province. **Answers false on every path**, so the popup closes where 0x2995D0's stays. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-messagegoto.md.
addresses.evidence: decompiled and read whole, ret 4 at VA 0x69983A; the return is the last value with its low byte cleared

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::MessageGotoScreen
addresses.comment: **Slot 78: the Goto that goes to a screen.** Closes the side menus and the orders view and clears the selection. Then: the message's string at +0x4C being `open_diplomacy` (DIPLOEXPIRE's alone): selects its province (+0x44, null where none) and OpenCountryView(0); the type TECH_ONCE or TECH_REPEAT: OpenCountryView(2), which is a toggle, so a Goto with the technology screen up shuts it; BUILDING_DONE: centres on the province, else the first country's acting capital, else the second's; anything else nothing more. Always true. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-messagegoto.md.
addresses.evidence: decompiled and read whole, ret 4 at VA 0x64ABB4 for the first arm; CInGameIdler's table 0x15CEB54 slot 78

addresses.evidence: decompiled and read whole, ret 4 at VA 0x64AAF6; CInGameIdler's table 0x15CEB54 slot 79
